scale.5: bounded repeated reproduction and public evidence

criteria.requirement: Drive, steer, stop and return to practice
Native form keys never unexpectedly drive
Scenario model routes reach intended targets
Prediction precedes movement and review
Scrub/replay restores world and pauses inspection
Concurrent pointer and driving inputs have explicit ownership
Hidden scenes pause simulation and drawing
Modal guidance isolates driving input and restores focus
Initial and runtime graphics failure keep a usable fallback
Camera consent/denial leaves manual mode usable
Invalid or stale hand observations never drive
Camera/worker/frame resources close and recover
Primary controls are reachable with44px targets
An immediate keyboard stop is available
Main visit and model assets use local dependencies
History/dynamic buffers and idle rendering are bounded
Portable loopback server, MIME and public boundaries
Public guide, screenshots, own license and third-party attribution
Reproducible fresh lockfile install and checks
Repeatable core, recovery and final browser journeys

limitations: Implementation-agent judgments, not independent human ratings, physical-device learning studies, or actual driving validation.
